vivian: Alert from a customer: restore job failing with KMS PermissionDenied after this morning's RBAC cleanup.
rohan: which snapshot / logs?
vivian: snapshot=db-snap-2026-03-21 region=us-central1\n```
2026-04-05T09:12:08Z ERROR restore: decrypt error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller lacks cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter\n2026-04-05T09:12:08Z INFO restore_id=rs-773
```
infra-bot: Detected IAM change: removed role storage.admin from serviceAccount:uploader@redwood-prod at 2026-04-05T08:50:03Z
sarah: uploader SA used to have a side KMS grant via that broad role. The backup key's IAM no longer lists uploader@redwood-prod. I'll add a temporary decrypt grant and set an expiry.
sarah: Applied: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter -> serviceAccount:uploader@redwood-prod with expiration 2026-04-05T10:00:00Z. Re-running restore...
vivian: restore succeeded for tenant. Thanks.
jeff: next steps: (SEC) inventory all workflows where uploader invokes KMS decrypt; (ENG) refactor restore path to use backup-decryptor SA; (SRE) add pre-merge check that diffs `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` against baseline and runs tiny restore smoke. Sarah, please file ENGSEC ticket with logs and revoke time.\nvivian: filed ENGSEC-5502 and will monitor. :thumbsup
